[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Implementation of waste management programs such as proper segregation and collection of garbage, and promotion of composting and recycling.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Monitoring and inspection of food establishments and public markets to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Provision of adequate sewage and drainage systems to prevent flooding and water contamination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Promotion of personal hygiene practices such as hand washing and use of face masks in public.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Strict enforcement of environmental laws and regulations and imposition of penalties for violators.
